analysis.summary: The provided document for Narmada Gelatine's Financial Year 2026 Annual Report consists of unreadable, garbled text and non-standard character encodings. As a result, no factual information, guidance, capex plans, or financial metrics could be extracted. Consequently, all thematic sections and management commitments are empty. The provided document contains unreadable garbled text, preventing the extraction of any financial or operational information. Consequently, no details regarding guidance, demand outlook, capex, margins, orders, capital allocation, or risks are available.

guidance.claim: The company expects to improve the quality and yield of gelatine through its technology absorption efforts.
guidance.quote: The Company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing awareness of the health benefits of gelatin is driving demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumers are becoming more aware of the health benefits of gelatin usage. Gelatin, being a rich source of collagen, is recognised for boosting joint health, skin elasticity, and hair strength, driving its demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand for gelatine is being driven by an aging population and increasing demand for convenience food and beverages.
demand_outlook.quote: Owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world, the demand for medicines is expected to increase. There is also increasing demand for convenience food and beverages due to changing lifestyles, increasing working population as consumers lacks the time to prepare home – cooked food and are more inclined towards convenience food products. These are driving the growth in gelatine demand world over.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is discussing the installation of a 2 MW solar power plant within its factory premises.
capex_expansion.quote: Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made no capital investment on energy conservation equipment during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital investment on energy conservation equipment : Nil

margins_costs.claim: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1% due to better yield, and power and fuel costs decreased by 1.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, which is due to better yield, power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost stood at 8.21% of revenue from operations, up from 7.17% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Employee cost stood at 8.21% (7.17% previous year) of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased to 6.35% of revenue from operations compared to 6.23% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Other expenses were on the higher side at 6.35% as compared to the previous year at 6.23% of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: Profit growth was driven by higher gelatin prices, better yield, and lower power and fuel consumption.
margins_costs.quote: Growth led by higher price of gelatin, better yield and lower consumption of power and fuel.

margins_costs.claim: The average selling price of gelatine increased by 3.28%, while the price of DCP decreased by 5%.
margins_costs.quote: Average selling price of gelatine increased by 3.28% but DCP decreased by 5% as compared to last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume of gelatine and DCP decreased by 5% and 8% respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume of gelatine / DCP decreased by 5%/ 8%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes is a primary market barrier threatening traditional animal-sourced gelatin.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers. Traditional gelatin made from animal sources is in danger due to this trend, as consumers look for alternatives that take sustainability and ethics into account.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cultural and religious prohibitions are hindering market growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Furthermore, cultural and religious prohibitions are impeding market growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Low-cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China and blended with high-quality Indian gelatin.
risks_headwinds.quote: According to the minutes of the meeting of the Drugs Consultative Committee – there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in the manufacturing of capsules.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing good quality crushed bones, the company's main raw material, is a major concern.
risks_headwinds.quote: The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.

management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.

management_commitments.quote: The Company shall constantly strive to ensure strong corporate culture which emphasizes on integrating CSR values with business objective.
